title: The Truth About Chemical Drain Cleaners
description: Many homeowners believe pouring chemical drain cleaner down a slow drain is a safe, quick fix for any blockage. In reality, caustic drain cleaners rely on exothermic chemical reactions to break down matter. This process generates heat that can deform thin-wall PVC piping, damage seals, and corrode older metal pipe walls. Furthermore, standing chemical solutions pose severe chemical burn hazards to plumbing technicians who must later clear the line mechanically. For persistent clogs or main line backups, mechanical clearing methods like drain augers or hydro-jetting provide a safer, more reliable solution without risking the structural integrity of the drainage system.

Furthermore, standing chemical solutions pose severe chemical burn hazards to plumbing technicians who must later clear the line mechanically. For persistent clogs or main line backups, mechanical clearing methods like drain augers or hydro-jetting provide a safer, more reliable solution without risking the structural integrity of the drainage system.
